overview: This enum marks visual effects that behave as traveling projectiles.

None.simple: A regular visual effect with no projectile contact rules.
None.technical: uint8 value 0 and the Effect row constructor default. On collision it runs OnCollisionContact. The projectile finish branch is skipped. 979 exported Effect rows use it.

Projectile.simple: A visual effect that travels and stops when it hits something.
Projectile.technical: uint8 value 1. Core checks spell it as EGameEffectType(1). It finishes on contact, clears the source attack flag at Initialize, sweeps characters and destructibles, uses collision-priority finish rules and filters external-force targets. Character controllers bind collision callbacks only for this type. 153 exported Effect rows use it.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. No exported row uses it and no branch compares against it. The core checks test only for value 1, so it follows the non-projectile contact path.

notes: Projectile contact can be suppressed by ThroughDestructibleObjectType and game trace channel blockers.
Character action controllers use slot 42 to bind extra collision callbacks for projectile effects.
Supplied Effect exports contain 979 None rows and 153 Projectile rows. No Invalid row appears.
